meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取解析流式细胞术标准数据文件并支持生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要处理流式细胞术实验的 FCS 数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 就能处理 FCS 格式的流式细胞术文件:读取其中的事件数据为数字数组,查看文件和通道信息,导出为 CSV 或生成新 FCS 文件。
howto.when: 当你提出与 FCS 文件有关的处理需求时触发,比如解析元数据、把事件转成 NumPy 数组、创建新文件等。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件,告诉我总共有多少个事件、多少通道。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并报告数量。

say.text: 把这个 FCS 文件的事件数据导出成 CSV 表格。
say.note: Claude 会读取并生成 CSV 文件。

say.text: 用我提供的数组,生成名为 output.fcs 的 FCS 3.1 文件。
say.note: Claude 会用 create_fcs 写入新文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can read and write FCS flow cytometry files: load event data into numeric arrays, inspect file and channel metadata, export to CSV, or create new FCS files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to process an FCS file, such as parsing metadata, converting events to NumPy arrays, or creating a new file.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and tell me how many events and channels it has.
say_en.note: Claude will parse it and report the counts.

say_en.text: Export the events of this FCS file to a CSV table.
say_en.note: Claude will read it and produce a CSV file.

say_en.text: Generate an FCS 3.1 file named output.fcs using the array I provide.
say_en.note: Claude will use create_fcs to write it.
